# Access refusal codes

**For:** integrators and operators. Every code the access evaluator refuses
a request under, with the status the caller receives. A `403` names its code
in the problem's `detail`; a `404` answers as if the data did not exist and
names nothing. A `refused-confidentiality` answers `404` instead at a level
the access policy conceals. The access log records the code either way. What each step
decides is on [How FerroEHR decides access](../explanation/access-model.md).

| Code | Answer |
|---|---|
| `refused-opt-out` | 404 |
| `refused-restricted` | 404 |
| `refused-consent-denied` | 403 |
| `refused-policy-denied` | 403 |
| `refused-sensitivity` | 403 |
| `refused-confidentiality` | 403 |
| `refused-no-care-relationship` | 403 |
| `refused-outside-episode` | 403 |
| `refused-purpose-missing` | 403 |
| `refused-reason-missing` | 403 |
| `refused-consent-required` | 403 |
| `refused-not-subject` | 403 |
| `refused-not-represented` | 403 |
| `refused-consent-reference-missing` | 403 |
| `refused-excluded` | 403 |
| `refused-conflict` | 403 |
